pli-tv-kd2:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
pli-tv-kd2:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā dhammaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd2:1.1.4: te labhanti aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu pemaṃ, labhanti pasādaṃ, labhanti aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pakkhaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:1.2.1: atha kho rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd2:1.2.2: etarahi kho aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā dhammaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd2:1.2.4: te labhanti aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu pemaṃ, labhanti pasādaṃ, labhanti aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pakkhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:1.2.5: yaṃ nūna ayyāpi cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipateyyun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.1: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.3: idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi: etarahi kho aññatitthiyā paribbājakā . . . aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.7: sādhu bhante ayyāpi cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipateyyun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd2:1.4.1: atha kho bhagavā rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd2:1.4.2: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd2:1.4.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd2:1.4.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitun ti. ||4||1||
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.2: bhagavatā anuññātaṃ cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitun ti te
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.3: cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā tuṇhī nisīdanti.
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā tuṇhī nisīdissanti seyyathāpi mūgasūkarā.
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.10: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā dhammaṃ bhāsitun ti. ||1||2||
pli-tv-kd2:3.1.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd2:3.1.2: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ yāni mayā bhikkhūnaṃ paññattāni sikkhāpadāni tāni nesaṃ pātimokkhuddesaṃ anujāneyyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:3.2.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd2:3.2.2: idha mayhaṃ bhikkhave rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ yāni mayā bhikkhūnaṃ paññattāni sikkhāpadāni tāni nesaṃ pātimokkhuddesaṃ anujāneyyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.3: suṇātu me bhante saṃgho. ajj' uposatho pannaraso.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho uposathaṃ kareyya pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.8: taṃ sabbeva santā sādhukaṃ suṇoma manasikaroma.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.12: yathā kho pana paccekapuṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti, evaṃ eva evarūpāya parisāya yāvatatiyaṃ anussāvitaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.13: yo pana bhikkhu yāvatatiyaṃ anussāviyamāne saramāno santiṃ āpattiṃ nāvikareyya, sampajānamusāvād' assa hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.14: sampajānamusāvādo kho panāyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.15: tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddhāpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā,
pli-tv-kd2:3.4.2: ādiṃ etaṃ, mukhaṃ etaṃ, pamukhaṃ etaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, tena vuccati pātimokkhan ti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.4.4: piyavacanaṃ etaṃ, garuvacanaṃ etaṃ, sagāravasappatissādhivacanaṃ etaṃ āyasmanto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.4.6: ācikkhissāmi desessāmi paññāpessāmi paṭṭhapessāmi vivarissāmi vibhajissāmi uttānikarissāmi pakāsessāmi.
pli-tv-kd2:3.4.10: yāvatikā tassā parisāya therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca, ete vuccanti sabbeva santā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.5.2: therassa vā navassa vā majjhimassa vā pañcannaṃ vā āpattikkhandhānaṃ aññatarā āpatti sattannaṃ vā āpattikkhandhānaṃ aññatarā āpatti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.5.4: so deseyya, so vivareyya, so uttānikareyya, so pakāseyya saṃghamajjhe vā gaṇamajjhe vā ekapuggale vā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.5.6: anajjhāpannā vā hoti āpajjitvā vā vuṭṭhitā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.1: yathā kho pana paccekapuṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hotīti
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.2: yathā ekena eko puṭṭho vyākareyya, evaṃ eva tassā parisāya jānitabbaṃ maṃ pucchatīti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.6: sakim pi anussāvitaṃ hoti dutiyam pi anussāvitaṃ hoti tatiyam pi anussāvitaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.10: ajjhāpannā vā hoti āpajjitvā vā avuṭṭhitā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.12: na deseyya na vivareyya na uttānikareyya na pakāseyya saṃghamajjhe vā gaṇamajjhe vā ekapuggale vā. ||6||
pli-tv-kd2:3.7.6: paṭhamassa jhānassa adhigamāya antarāyiko, dutiyassa jhānassa adhigamāya antarāyiko, tatiyassa jhānassa adhigamāya antarāyiko, catutthassa jhānassa adhigamāya antarāyiko, jhānānaṃ vimokkhānaṃ samādhīnaṃ samāpattīnaṃ nekkhammānaṃ nissaraṇānaṃ pavivekānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhigamāya antarāyiko.
pli-tv-kd2:3.8.2: ajjhāpannā vā hoti āpajjitvā vā avuṭṭhitā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.8.4: āvikātabbā 'ti āvikātabbā saṃghamajjhe vā gaṇamajjhe vā ekapuggale vā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.8.7: paṭhamassa jhānassa adhigamāya phāsu hoti, dutiyassa jhānassa adhigamāya phāsu hoti, tatiyassa jhānassa adhigamāya phāsu hoti, catutthassa jhānassa adhigamāya phāsu hoti, jhānānaṃ vimokkhānaṃ samādhīnaṃ samāpattīnaṃ nekkhammānaṃ nissaraṇānaṃ pavivekānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhigamāya phāsu hotīti. ||8||3||
pli-tv-kd2:4.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave uposathe pātimokkhaṃ uddisitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:4.2.3: pakkhassa tikkhattuṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti cātuddase pannarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa.
pli-tv-kd2:4.2.5: na bhikkhave pakkhassa tikkhattuṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:4.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave sakiṃ pakkhassa cātuddase vā pannarase vā pātimokkhaṃ uddisitun ti. ||2||4||
pli-tv-kd2:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū yathāparisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti sakāya-sakāya parisāya.
pli-tv-kd2:5.1.3: na bhikkhave yathāparisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ sakāya-sakāya parisāya.
pli-tv-kd2:5.2.4: kittāvatā nu kho sāmaggī hoti, yāvatā ekāvāso udāhu sabbā paṭhavīti.
pli-tv-kd2:5.2.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave ettāvatā sāmaggī yāvatā ekāvāso 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:5.3.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahākappino Rājagahe viharati Maddakucchismiṃ migadāye.
pli-tv-kd2:5.3.2: atha kho āyasmato Mahākappinassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd2:5.3.3: gaccheyyaṃ vāhaṃ uposathaṃ na vā gaccheyyaṃ, gaccheyyaṃ vā saṃghakammaṃ na vā gaccheyyaṃ, atha khv āhaṃ visuddho paramāya visuddhiyā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd2:5.4.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato Mahākappinassa cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya
pli-tv-kd2:5.4.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito Maddakucchismiṃ migadāye āyasmato Mahākappinassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd2:5.4.4: āyasmāpi kho Mahākappino bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Mahākappinaṃ bhagavā etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.2: nanu te Kappina rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.3: gaccheyyaṃ vāhaṃ uposathaṃ na vā gaccheyyaṃ, gaccheyyaṃ vā saṃghakammaṃ na vā gaccheyyaṃ, atha khv āhaṃ visuddho paramāya visuddhiyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.5: tumhe ce brāhmaṇā uposathaṃ na sakkarissatha, na garukarissatha, na mānessatha, na pūjessatha, atha ko carahi uposathaṃ sakkarissati garukarissati mānessati pūjessati.
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.6: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa uposathaṃ, mā no agamāsi,
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.7: gacch' eva saṃghakammaṃ, mā no agamāsīti.
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.8: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Mahākappino bhagavato paccassosi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd2:5.6.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Mahakappinaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā
pli-tv-kd2:5.6.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Maddakucchismiṃ migadāye āyasmato Mahākappinassa pamukhe antarahito Gijjhakūṭe pabbate pāturahosi. ||6||5||
pli-tv-kd2:6.1.3: ettāvatā sāmaggī yāvatā ekāvāso 'ti. kittāvatā nu kho ekāvāso hotīti.
pli-tv-kd2:6.1.8: pabbatanimittaṃ, pāsāṇanimittaṃ, vananimittaṃ, rukkhanimittaṃ, magganimittaṃ, vammikanimittaṃ, nadīnimittaṃ, udakanimittaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:6.1.9: nimitte kittetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd2:6.1.12: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho etehi nimittehi sīmaṃ sammanneyya samānasaṃvāsaṃ ekuposathaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:6.2.3: saṃgho etehi nimittehi sīmaṃ sammannati samānasaṃvāsaṃ ekuposathaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:6.2.4: yassāyasmato khamati etehi nimittehi sīmāya sammuti samānasaṃvāsāya ekuposathāya, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:6.2.6: sammatā sīmā saṃghena etehi nimittehi samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā.
pli-tv-kd2:6.2.7: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||2||6||
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.3: atimahatiyo sīmāyo sammannanti catuyojanikāpi pañcayojanikāpi chayojanikāpi.
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.4: bhikkhū uposathaṃ āgacchantā uddissamāne pi pātimokkhe āgacchanti uddiṭṭhamatte pi āgacchanti antarāpi parivasanti.
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.6: na bhikkhave atimahatī sīmā sammannitabbā catuyojanikā vā pañcayojanikā vā chayojanikā vā.
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave tiyojanaparamaṃ sīmaṃ sammannitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:7.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nadīpāraṃ sīmaṃ sammannanti.
pli-tv-kd2:7.2.2: uposathaṃ āgacchantā bhikkhū pi vuyhanti pattāpi vuyhanti cīvarāni pi vuyhanti.
pli-tv-kd2:7.2.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave yatth' assa dhuvanāvā vā dhuvasetu vā, evarūpaṃ nadīpāraṃ sīmaṃ sammannitun ti. ||2||7||
pli-tv-kd2:8.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū anupariveṇiyaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti asaṃketena.
pli-tv-kd2:8.1.5: na bhikkhave anupariveṇiyaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ asaṃketena.
pli-tv-kd2:8.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave uposathāgāraṃ sammannitvā uposathaṃ kātuṃ yaṃ saṃgho ākaṅkhati vihāraṃ vā aḍḍhayogaṃ vā pāsādaṃ vā hammiyaṃ vā guhaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:8.2.3: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ vihāraṃ uposathāgāraṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:8.2.7: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa vihārassa uposathāgārassa sammuti, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:8.2.10: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:8.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse dve uposathāgārāni sammatāni honti.
pli-tv-kd2:8.3.3: idha uposatho kariyissati idha uposatho kariyissatīti.
pli-tv-kd2:8.3.5: na bhikkhave ekasmiṃ āvāse dve uposathāgārāni sammannitabbāni.
pli-tv-kd2:8.3.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekaṃ samūhanitvā ekattha uposathaṃ kātuṃ. ||3||
pli-tv-kd2:8.4.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ uposathāgāraṃ samūhaneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:8.4.8: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa uposathāgārassa samugghāto, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:8.4.11: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||4||8||
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse atikhuddakaṃ uposathāgāraṃ sammataṃ hoti. tadah' uposathe mahā bhikkhusaṃgho sannipatito hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.2: bhikkhū asammatāya bhūmiyā nisinnā pātimokkhaṃ assosuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.3: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.5: uposathāgāraṃ sammannitvā uposatho kātabbo 'ti, mayañ ca asammatāya bhūmiyā nisinnā pātimokkhaṃ assosumhā. kato nu kho amhākaṃ uposatho akato nu kho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.7: sammatāya vā bhikkhave bhūmiyā nisinnā asammatāya vā, yato pātimokkhaṃ suṇāti, kato 'v' ass' uposatho. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.1: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho yāvamahantaṃ uposathapamukhaṃ ākaṅkhati, tāvamahantaṃ uposathapamukhaṃ sammannatu.
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.4: nimitte kittetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.7: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho etehi nimittehi uposathapamukhaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.12: yassāyasmato khamati etehi nimittehi uposathapamukhassa sammuti, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.15: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||2||9||
pli-tv-kd2:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadah' uposathe navakā bhikkhū paṭhamataraṃ sannipatitvā
pli-tv-kd2:10.1.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave tadah' uposathe therehi bhikkhūhi paṭhamataraṃ sannipatitun ti. ||1||10||
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā honti.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.3: amhākaṃ āvāse uposatho kariyatu amhākaṃ āvāse uposatho kariyatū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.5: idha pana bhikkhave sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā honti,
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.7: amhākaṃ āvāse uposatho kariyatu amhākaṃ āvāse uposatho kariyatū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.8: tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi sabbeh' eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitvā uposatho kātabbo,
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.9: yattha vā pana thero bhikkhu viharati tattha sannipatitvā uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.10: na tv eva vaggena saṃghena uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahākassapo Andhakavindā Rājagahaṃ uposathaṃ āgacchanto antarā magge nadiṃ taranto manaṃ vuḷho ahosi, cīvarāni 'ssa allāni.
pli-tv-kd2:12.1.4: idhāhaṃ āvuso Andhakavindā Rājagahaṃ uposathaṃ āgacchanto antarā magge nadiṃ taranto man' amhi vuḷho,
pli-tv-kd2:12.1.7: yā sā bhikkhave saṃghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā, saṃgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammannatu. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.4: yā sā saṃghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā, yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.7: yā sā saṃghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā, saṃgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammannati.
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.8: yassāyasmato khamati etissā sīmāya ticīvarena avippavāsāya sammuti, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.10: sammatā sā sīmā saṃghena ticīvarena avippavāsā.
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.11: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:12.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhagavatā ticīvarena avippavāsasammuti anuññātā 'ti antaraghare cīvarāni nikkhipanti.
pli-tv-kd2:12.3.2: tāni cīvarāni nassanti pi ḍayhanti pi undurehi pi khajjanti,
pli-tv-kd2:12.3.6: idha mayaṃ āvuso bhagavatā ticīvarena avippavāsasammuti anuññātā 'ti antaraghare cīvarāni nikkhipimhā,
pli-tv-kd2:12.3.7: tāni cīvarāni naṭṭhāni pi daḍḍhāni pi undurehi pi khāyitāni. tena mayaṃ duccolā lūkhacīvarā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:12.3.9: yā sā bhikkhave saṃghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā, saṃgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammannatu ṭhapetvā gāmañ ca gāmūpacārañ ca. ||3||
pli-tv-kd2:12.4.4: yā sā saṃghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā, yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammanneyya ṭhapetvā gāmañ ca gāmūpacārañ ca.
pli-tv-kd2:12.4.7: yā sā saṃghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā, saṃgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammannati ṭhapetvā gāmañ ca gāmūpacārañ ca.
pli-tv-kd2:12.4.8: yassāyasmato khamati etissā sīmāya ticīvarena avippavāsāya sammuti ṭhapetvā gāmañ ca gāmūpacārañ ca, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:12.4.10: sammatā sā sīmā saṃghena ticīvarena avippavāsā ṭhapetvā gāmañ ca gāmūpacārañ ca.
pli-tv-kd2:12.4.11: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd2:12.5.1: sīmaṃ bhikkhave sammannantena paṭhamaṃ samānasaṃvāsasīmā sammannitabbā, pacchā ticīvarena avippavāso sammannitabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:12.5.2: sīmaṃ bhikkhave samūhanantena paṭhamaṃ ticīvarena avippavāso samūhantabbo, pacchā samānasaṃvāsasīmā samūhantabbā.
pli-tv-kd2:12.5.3: evañ ca pana bhikkhave ticīvarena avippavāso samūhantabbo:
pli-tv-kd2:12.5.6: yo so saṃghena ticīvarena avippavāso sammato, yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho taṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ samūhaneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:12.5.9: yo so saṃghena ticīvarena avippavāso sammato, saṃgho taṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ samūhanati.
pli-tv-kd2:12.5.10: yassāyasmato khamati etassa ticīvarena avippavāsassa samugghāto, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:12.5.13: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd2:12.6.1: evañ ca pana bhikkhave sīmā samūhantabbā:
pli-tv-kd2:12.6.4: yā sā saṃghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā, yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho taṃ sīmaṃ samūhaneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:12.6.7: yā sā saṃghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā, saṃgho taṃ sīmaṃ samūhanati.
pli-tv-kd2:12.6.8: yassāyasmato khamati etissā sīmāya samānasaṃvāsāya ekuposathāya samugghāto, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:12.6.10: samūhatā sā sīmā saṃghena samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā.
pli-tv-kd2:12.6.11: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd2:12.7.1: asammatāya bhikkhave sīmāya aṭṭhapitāya yaṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati, yā tassa vā gāmassa gāmasīmā nigamassa vā nigamasīmā, ayaṃ tattha samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā.
pli-tv-kd2:12.7.2: agāmake ce bhikkhave araññe, samantā sattabbhantarā ayaṃ tattha samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā.
pli-tv-kd2:12.7.6: nadiyā vā bhikkhave samudde vā jātassare vā yaṃ majjhimassa purisassa samantā udakukkhepā, ayaṃ tattha samānasaṃvāsā ekuposathā 'ti. ||7||12||
pli-tv-kd2:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sīmāya sīmaṃ sambhindanti.
pli-tv-kd2:13.1.3: yesaṃ bhikkhave sīmā paṭhamaṃ sammatā, tesaṃ taṃ kammaṃ dhammikaṃ akuppaṃ ṭhānārahaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:13.1.4: yesaṃ bhikkhave sīmā pacchā sammatā, tesaṃ taṃ kammaṃ adhammikaṃ kuppaṃ aṭṭhānārahaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:13.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sīmāya sīmaṃ ajjhottharanti.
pli-tv-kd2:13.2.3: yesaṃ bhikkhave sīmā paṭhamaṃ sammatā, tesaṃ taṃ kammaṃ dhammikaṃ akuppaṃ ṭhānārahaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:13.2.4: yesaṃ bhikkhave sīmā pacchā sammatā, tesaṃ taṃ kammaṃ adhammikaṃ kuppaṃ aṭṭhānārahaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:13.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave sīmaṃ sammannantena sīmantarikaṃ ṭhapetvā sīmaṃ sammannitun ti. ||2||13||
pli-tv-kd2:14.1.4: dve 'me bhikkhave uposathā cātuddasiko ca pannarasiko ca, ime kho bhikkhave dve uposathā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:14.2.9: tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ adhammena vaggaṃ uposathakammaṃ, na bhikkhave evarūpaṃ uposathakammaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd2:14.2.10: na ca mayā evarūpaṃ uposathakammaṃ anuññātaṃ. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:14.3.1: tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ adhammena samaggaṃ uposathakammaṃ, na bhikkhave evarūpaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd2:14.3.3: tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ dhammena vaggaṃ uposathakammaṃ, na bhikkhave evarūpaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd2:14.3.5: tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ dhammena samaggaṃ uposathakammaṃ, evarūpaṃ bhikkhave uposathakammaṃ kātabbaṃ evarūpañ ca mayā uposathakammaṃ anuññātaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:14.3.6: tasmāt iha bhikkhave evarūpaṃ uposathakammaṃ karissāma yad idaṃ dhammena samaggan ti,
pli-tv-kd2:14.3.7: evañ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabban ti. ||3||14||
pli-tv-kd2:15.1.7: nidānaṃ uddisitvā cattāri pārājikāni uddisitvā avasesaṃ sutena sāvetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:15.1.9: nidānaṃ uddisitvā cattāri pārājikāni uddisitvā terasa saṃghādisese uddisitvā avasesaṃ sutena sāvetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:15.1.11: nidānaṃ uddisitvā cattāri pārājikāni uddisitvā terasa saṃghādisese uddisitvā dve aniyate uddisitvā avasesaṃ sutena sāvetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:15.3.1: tena kho pana samayena Kosalesu janapadesu aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadah' uposathe savarabhayaṃ ahosi.
pli-tv-kd2:15.3.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave sati antarāye saṃkhittena pātimokkhaṃ uddisitun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd2:15.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū asati pi antarāye saṃkhittena pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.4.3: na bhikkhave asati antarāye saṃkhittena pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:15.4.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave sati antarāye saṃkhittena pātimokkhaṃ uddisituṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:15.4.7: rājantarāyo corantarāyo agyantarāyo udakantarāyo manussantarāyo amanussantarāyo vāḷantarāyo siriṃsapantarāyo jīvitantarāyo brahmacariyantarāyo.
pli-tv-kd2:15.4.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpesu antarāyesu saṃkhittena pātimokkhaṃ uddisituṃ, asati antarāye vitthārenā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd2:15.5.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe anajjhiṭṭhā dhammaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.5.3: na bhikkhave saṃghamajjhe anajjhiṭṭhena dhammo bhāsitabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:15.5.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave therena bhikkhunā sāmaṃ vā dhammaṃ bhāsituṃ paraṃ vā ajjhesitun ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd2:15.6.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe asammatā vinayaṃ pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.6.3: na bhikkhave saṃghamajjhe asammatena vinayo pucchitabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:15.6.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave saṃghamajjhe sammatena vinayaṃ pucchituṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:15.6.7: attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ parena vā paro sammannitabbo. ||6||
pli-tv-kd2:15.7.1: kathañ ca attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:15.7.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ itthannāmaṃ vinayaṃ puccheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.7.9: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, itthannāmo itthannāmaṃ vinayaṃ puccheyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.8.1: tena kho pana samayena pesalā bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe sammatā vinayaṃ pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.8.2: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū labhanti āghātaṃ, labhanti appaccayaṃ, vadhena tajjenti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.8.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave saṃghamajjhe sammatena pi parisaṃ oloketvā puggalaṃ tulayitvā vinayaṃ pucchitun ti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd2:15.9.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe asammatā vinayaṃ vissajjenti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.9.3: na bhikkhave saṃghamajjhe asammatena vinayo vissajjetabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:15.9.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave saṃghamajjhe sammatena vinayaṃ vissajjetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:15.9.7: attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ parena vā paro sammannitabbo. ||9||
pli-tv-kd2:15.10.1: kathañ ca attanā vā attānaṃ sammannitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:15.10.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ itthannāmena vinayaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.10.9: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, itthannāmo itthannāmena vinayaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.11.1: tena kho pana samayena pesalā bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe sammatā vinayaṃ vissajjenti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.11.2: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū labhanti āghātaṃ, labhanti appaccayaṃ, vadhena tajjenti.
pli-tv-kd2:15.11.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave saṃghamajjhe sammatena pi parisaṃ oloketvā puggalaṃ tulayitvā vinayaṃ vissajjetun ti. ||11||15||
pli-tv-kd2:16.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anokāsakataṃ bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.1.3: na bhikkhave anokāsakato bhikkhu āpattiyā codetabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:16.1.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave okāsaṃ kārāpetvā āpattiyā codetuṃ
pli-tv-kd2:16.1.6: karotu āyasmā okāsaṃ ahaṃ taṃ vattukāmo 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:16.2.1: tena kho pana samayena pesalā bhikkhū chabbaggiye bhikkhū okāsaṃ kārāpetvā āpattiyā codenti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.2.2: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū labhanti āghātaṃ, labhanti appaccayaṃ, vadhena tajjenti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave kate pi okāse puggalaṃ tulayitvā āpattiyā codetun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:16.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pur' amhākaṃ pesalā bhikkhū okāsaṃ kārāpentīti paṭigacc' eva suddhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anāpattikānaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe okāsaṃ kārāpenti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.3.3: na bhikkhave suddhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anāpattikānaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe okāso kārāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:16.3.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave puggalaṃ tulayitvā okāsaṃ kārāpetun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd2:16.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe adhammakammaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.4.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave adhammakamme kayiramāne paṭikkositun ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd2:16.5.1: tena kho pana samayena pesalā bhikkhū chabbaggiyehi bhikkhūhi adhammakamme kayiramāne paṭikkosanti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.5.2: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū labhanti āghātaṃ, labhanti appaccayaṃ, vadhena tajjenti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.5.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave diṭṭhim pi āvikātun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.5.6: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū labhanti āghātaṃ, labhanti appaccayaṃ, vadhena tajjenti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.5.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave catuhi pañcahi paṭikkosituṃ, dvīhi tīhi diṭṭhiṃ āvikātuṃ, ekena adhiṭṭhātuṃ
pli-tv-kd2:16.6.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe pātimokkhaṃ uddisamānā sañcicca na sāventi.
pli-tv-kd2:16.6.3: na bhikkhave pātimokkhuddesakena sañcicca na sāvetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:16.7.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Udāyi saṃghassa pātimokkhuddesako hoti kākassarako.
pli-tv-kd2:16.7.2: atha kho āyasmato Udāyissa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd2:16.7.4: pātimokkhuddesakena sāvetabban ti, ahañ c' amhi kākassarako. kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.8.1: tena kho pana samayena Devadatto sagahaṭṭhāya parisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddisati.
pli-tv-kd2:16.8.3: na bhikkhave sagahaṭṭhāya parisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:16.9.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe anajjhiṭṭhā pātimokkham uddisanti.
pli-tv-kd2:16.9.3: na bhikkhave saṃghamajjhe anajjhiṭṭhena pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:16.9.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave therādhikaṃ pātimokkhan ti. ||9||16|| aññatitthiyabhāṇavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:17.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Codanāvatthu tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd2:17.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Codanāvatthu tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd2:17.1.3: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse sambahulā bhikkhū viharanti,
pli-tv-kd2:17.1.4: tattha thero bhikkhu bālo hoti avyatto,
pli-tv-kd2:17.1.5: so na jānāti uposathaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā pātimokkhaṃ vā pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:17.2.1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd2:17.2.3: therādhikaṃ pātimokkhan ti, ayañ ca amhākaṃ thero bālo avyatto, na jānāti uposathaṃ vā . . . pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:17.2.4: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd2:17.2.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave yo tattha bhikkhu vyatto paṭibalo tassādheyyaṃ pātimokkhan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:17.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadah' uposathe sambahulā bhikkhū viharanti bālā avyattā,
pli-tv-kd2:17.3.2: te na jānanti uposathaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā pātimokkhaṃ vā pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:17.3.15: eten' eva upāyena yāva saṃghanavakaṃ ajjhesiṃsu
pli-tv-kd2:17.4.3: idha pana bhikkhave aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadah' uposathe sambahulā bhikkhū viharanti bālā avyattā,
pli-tv-kd2:17.4.4: te na jānanti uposathaṃ vā . . . pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:17.4.17: eten' eva upāyena yāva saṃghanavakaṃ ajjhesanti
pli-tv-kd2:17.5.1: tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi eko bhikkhu sāmantā āvāsā sajjukaṃ pāhetabbo
pli-tv-kd2:17.5.2: gācchāvuso saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā pātimokkhaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā āgacchā 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd2:17.6.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave therena bhikkhunā navaṃ bhikkhuṃ āṇāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:17.6.5: therena āṇattā navā bhikkhū na gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd2:17.6.7: na bhikkhave therena āṇattena agilānena na gantabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:18.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Codanāvatthusmiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā punad eva Rājagahaṃ paccāgacchi.
pli-tv-kd2:18.1.2: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhikkhū piṇḍāya carante pucchanti:
pli-tv-kd2:18.1.7: pakkhagaṇanamattam p' ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā na jānanti, kiṃ pan' ime aññaṃ kiñci kalyāṇaṃ jānissantīti.
pli-tv-kd2:18.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbeh' eva pakkhagaṇanaṃ uggahetun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:18.3.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhikkhū piṇḍāya carante pucchanti:
pli-tv-kd2:18.3.6: aññamaññam p' ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā na jānanti, kiṃ pan' ime aññaṃ kiñci kalyāṇaṃ jānissantīti.
pli-tv-kd2:18.4.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave tadah' uposathe gaṇamaggena vā gaṇetuṃ salākaṃ vā gahetun ti. ||4||18||
pli-tv-kd2:19.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ajānantā ajj' uposatho 'ti dūraṃ gāmaṃ piṇḍāya caranti.
pli-tv-kd2:19.1.2: te uddissamāne pi pātimokkhe āgacchanti uddiṭṭhamatte pi āgacchanti.
pli-tv-kd2:19.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave therena bhikkhunā kālavato ārocetun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:19.1.9: tena kho pana samayena aññataro thero kālavato na ssarati.
pli-tv-kd2:19.1.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhattakāle pi ārocetun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:19.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave yaṃ kālaṃ sarati, taṃ kālaṃ ārocetun ti. ||1||19||
pli-tv-kd2:20.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse uposathāgāraṃ uklāpaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū uposathāgāraṃ na sammajjissantīti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.2.2: kena nu kho uposathāgāraṃ sammajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave therena bhikkhunā navaṃ bhikkhuṃ āṇāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.2.5: therena āṇattā navā bhikkhū na sammajjanti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.2.7: na bhikkhave therena āṇattena agilānena na sammajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:20.3.1: tena kho pana samayena uposathāgāre āsanaṃ apaññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.3.2: bhikkhū chamāyaṃ nisīdanti. gattāni pi cīvarāni pi paṃsukitāni honti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.3.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave uposathāgāre āsanaṃ paññāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.3.6: kena nu kho uposathāgāre āsanaṃ paññāpetabban ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.3.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave therena bhikkhunā navaṃ bhikkhuṃ āṇāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.3.9: therena āṇattā navā bhikkhū na paññāpenti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.3.11: na bhikkhave therena āṇattena agilānena na paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:20.4.1: tena kho pana samayena uposathāgāre padīpo na hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.4.2: bhikkhū andhakāre kāyam pi cīvaram pi akkamanti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.4.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave uposathāgāre padīpaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.4.6: kena nu kho uposathāgāre padīpo kātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.4.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave therena bhikkhunā navaṃ bhikkhuṃ āṇāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.4.9: therena āṇattā navā bhikkhū na padīpenti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.4.11: na bhikkhave therena āṇattena agilānena na padīpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:20.5.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse āvāsikā bhikkhū n' eva pāniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti na paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.5.3: kathaṃ hi nāma āvāsikā bhikkhū n' eva pāniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti na paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpessantīti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.5.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetun ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd2:20.6.2: kena nu kho pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabban ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.6.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave therena bhikkhunā navaṃ bhikkhuṃ āṇāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.6.5: therena āṇattā navā bhikkhū na upaṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-kd2:20.6.7: na bhikkhave therena āṇattena agilānena na upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:21.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bālā avyattā disaṃgamikā ācariyupajjhāye na āpucchiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd2:21.1.3: idha pana bhikkhave sambahulā bhikkhū bālā avyattā disaṃgamikā ācariyupajjhāye na āpucchanti.
pli-tv-kd2:21.1.6: te ce bhikkhave bālā avyattā aññe bāle avyatte apadiseyyuṃ, na bhikkhave ācariyupajjhāyehi anujānitabbā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.1.8: te ce bhikkhave bālā avyattā ananuññātā ācariyupajjhāyehi gaccheyyuṃ, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.1: idha pana bhikkhave aññatarasmiṃ āvāse sambahulā bhikkhū viharanti bālā avyattā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.2: te na jānanti uposathaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā pātimokkhaṃ vā pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.3: tattha añño bhikkhu āgacchati bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.4: tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi so bhikkhu saṃgahetabbo anuggahetabbo upalāpetabbo upaṭṭhāpetabbo cuṇṇena mattikāya dantakaṭṭhena mukhodakena.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.5: no ce saṃgaṇheyyuṃ anugaṇheyyuṃ upalāpeyyuṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ cuṇṇena mattikāya dantakaṭṭhena mukhodakena, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.1: idha pana bhikkhave aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadah' uposathe sambahulā bhikkhū viharanti bālā avyattā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.2: te na jānanti uposathaṃ vā . . . pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.3: tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi eko bhikkhu sāmantā āvāsā sajjukaṃ pāhetabbo
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.4: gacchāvuso saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā pātimokkhaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā āgacchā 'ti. evaṃ ce
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.6: no ce labhetha, tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi sabbeh' eva yattha jānanti uposathaṃ vā . . . pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā, so āvāso gantabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.1: idha pana bhikkhave aññatarasmiṃ āvāse sambahulā bhikkhū vassaṃ vasanti bālā avyattā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.2: te na jānanti uposathaṃ vā . . . pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.3: tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi eko bhikkhu sāmantā āvāsā sajjukaṃ pāhetabbo
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.4: gacchāvuso saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā pātimokkhaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā āgacchā 'ti. evaṃ ce
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.6: no ce labhetha, eko bhikkhu sattāhakālikaṃ pāhetabbo
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.7: gacchāvuso saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā pātimokkhaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā āgacchā 'ti. evaṃ ce
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.9: no ce labhetha, na bhikkhave tehi bhikkhūhi tasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ vasitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.3: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.4: atthi bhante bhikkhu gilāno, so anāgato 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā pārisuddhiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.7: tena gilānena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.8: pārisuddhiṃ dammi, pārisuddhiṃ me hara, pārisuddhiṃ me ārocehīti
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.9: kāyena viññāpeti, vācāya viññāpeti, kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, dinnā hoti pārisuddhi,
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.10: na kāyena viññāpeti, na vācāyā viññāpeti, na kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, na dinnā hoti pārisuddhi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:22.2.1: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:22.2.2: no ce labhetha, so bhikkhave gilāno bhikkhu mañcena vā pīṭhena vā saṃghamajjhe ānetvā uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:22.2.3: sace bhikkhave gilānupaṭṭhākānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd2:22.2.4: sace kho mayaṃ gilānaṃ ṭhānā cāvessāma, ābādho vā abhivaḍḍhissati kālaṃkiriyā vā bhavissatīti, na bhikkhave gilāno ṭhānā cāvetabbo,
pli-tv-kd2:22.2.6: na tv eva vaggena saṃghena uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:22.3.1: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pārisuddhiyā tatth' eva pakkamati, aññassa dātabbā pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.3.2: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pārisuddhiyā tatth' eva vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.1: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pārisuddhiyā antarā magge pakkamati, anāhaṭā hoti pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.2: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pārisuddhiyā antarā magge vibbhamati, kālaṃ karoti
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.4: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pārisuddhiyā saṃghappatto pakkamati, āhaṭā hoti pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.5: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pārisuddhiyā saṃghappatto vibbhamati, kālaṃ karoti
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.7: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pārisuddhiyā saṃghappatto sutto na āroceti, pamatto na āroceti, samāpanno na āroceti, āhaṭā hoti pārisuddhi,
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.9: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave dinnāya pārisuddhiyā saṃghappatto sañcicca na āroceti, āhaṭā hoti pārisuddhi,
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.3: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.4: atthi bhante bhikkhu gilāno, so anāgato 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā chandaṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.7: tena gilānena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.8: chandaṃ dammi, chandaṃ me hara, chandaṃ me ārocehīti
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.9: kāyena viññāpeti, vācāya viññāpeti, kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, dinno hoti chando,
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.10: na kāyena viññāpeti, na vācāya viññāpeti, na kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, na dinno hoti chando. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:23.2.1: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:23.2.2: no ce labhetha, so bhikkhave gilāno bhikkhu mañcena vā pīṭhena vā saṃghamajjhe ānetvā kammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:23.2.3: sace bhikkhave gilānupaṭṭhākānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd2:23.2.4: sace kho mayaṃ gilānaṃ ṭhānā cāvessāma, ābādho vā abhivaḍḍhissati kālaṃkiriyā vā bhavissatīti, na bhikkhave gilāno ṭhānā cāvetabbo,
pli-tv-kd2:23.2.6: na tv eva vaggena saṃghena kammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.1: chandahārako ce bhikkhave dinne chande tatth' eva pakkamati, aññassa dātabbo chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.2: chandahārako ce bhikkhave dinne chande tatth' eva vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.24: chandahārako ce bhikkhave dinne chande antarā magge pakkamati, anāhaṭo hoti chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.34: anujānāmi bhikkhave tadah' uposathe pārisuddhiṃ dentena chandam pi dātuṃ santi saṃghassa karaṇīyan ti. ||3||23||
pli-tv-kd2:24.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ tadah' uposathe ñātakā gaṇhiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd2:24.1.3: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ tadah' uposathe ñātakā gaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.1.4: te ñātakā bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.1.5: iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto imaṃ bhikkhuṃ muhuttaṃ muñcatha yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu uposathaṃ karotīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.1: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.2: no ce labhetha, te ñātakā bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.3: iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ ekamantaṃ hotha yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu pārisuddhiṃ detīti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.4: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.5: no ce labhetha, te ñātakā bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.6: iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto imaṃ bhikkhuṃ muhuttaṃ nissīmaṃ netha yāva saṃgho uposathaṃ karotīti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.7: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.8: no ce labhetha, na tv eva vaggena saṃghena uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ tadah' uposathe rājāno gaṇhanti --la--
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.4: bhikkhū paccatthikā gaṇhanti. te bhikkhū paccatthikā bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.13: na tv eva vaggena saṃghena uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.2: sannipatatha bhikkhave, atthi saṃghassa karaṇīyan ti.
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.3: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.4: atthi bhante Gaggo nāma bhikkhu ummattako, so anāgato 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.6: atthi bhikkhu ummattako sarati pi uposathaṃ na pi sarati, sarati pi saṃghakammaṃ na pi sarati, atthi n' eva sarati,
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.7: āgacchati pi uposathaṃ na pi āgacchati, āgacchati pi saṃghakammaṃ na pi āgacchati, atthi n' eva āgacchati. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:25.2.1: tatra bhikkhave yv' āyaṃ ummattako sarati pi uposathaṃ na pi sarati, sarati pi saṃghakammaṃ na pi sarati, āgacchati pi uposathaṃ na pi āgacchati, āgacchati pi saṃghakammaṃ na pi āgacchati, anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpassa ummattakassa ummattakasammutiṃ dātuṃ. ||2||
pli-tv-kd2:25.3.5: sarati pi uposathaṃ na pi sarati, sarati pi saṃghakammaṃ na pi sarati, āgacchati pi uposathaṃ na pi āgacchati, āgacchati pi saṃghakammaṃ na pi āgacchati.
pli-tv-kd2:25.3.6: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho Gaggassa bhikkhuno ummattakassa ummattakasammutiṃ dadeyya
pli-tv-kd2:25.3.7: sareyya vā Gaggo bhikkhu uposathaṃ na vā sareyya, sareyya vā saṃghakammaṃ na vā sareyya, āgaccheyya vā uposathaṃ na vā āgaccheyya, āgaccheyya vā saṃghakammaṃ na vā āgaccheyya, saṃgho saha vā Gaggena vinā vā Gaggena uposatham kareyya saṃghakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.3: sarati pi uposathaṃ . . . na pi āgacchati. saṃgho
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.5: sareyya vā Gaggo . . . na vā āgaccheyya, saṃgho saha vā Gaggena vinā vā Gaggena uposathaṃ karissati saṃghakammaṃ karissati.
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.6: yassāyasmato khamati Gaggassa bhikkhuno ummattakassa ummattakasammutiyā dānaṃ
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.7: sareyya vā . . . saṃghakammaṃ karissati, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.9: dinnā saṃghena Gaggassa bhikkhuno ummattakassa ummattakasammuti
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.11: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||4||25||
pli-tv-kd2:26.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadah' uposathe cattāro bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.1.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd2:26.1.4: uposatho kātabbo 'ti, mayañ c' amhā cattāro janā. kathaṃ nu kho amhehi uposatho kātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.1.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave catunnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd2:26.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadah' uposathe tayo bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.2.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd2:26.2.3: bhagavatā anuññātaṃ catunnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisituṃ, mayañ c' amhā tayo janā. kathaṃ nu kho amhehi uposatho kātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.3.2: vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena te bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd2:26.3.5: yad' āyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, mayaṃ aññamaññaṃ pārisuddhiuposathaṃ kareyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.3.6: therena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā te bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:26.4.1: navakena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā te bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:26.5.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadah' uposathe dve bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.5.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd2:26.5.3: bhagavatā anuññātaṃ catunnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisituṃ, tiṇṇannaṃ pārisuddhiuposathaṃ kātuṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:26.5.5: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi uposatho kātabbo 'ti.
